name: unifi AQ trmnl integration
description: Maintains a private TRMNL plugin that displays readings from a UniFi Protect UP-AirQuality sensor, with a poller on the local network pushing data to a TRMNL webhook. Assumes you own both the sensor and a TRMNL device and are comfortable running something on your own LAN.
